waiver_of_premium.value: Waives the sum of all future premiums of the basic plan if the life insured becomes totally and permanently disabled (unable to work for 12 months, loss of use of two limbs or both eyes or one of each, or unable to do 3 of 6 daily tasks).
waiver_of_premium.doc: Waiver of Premium Linked Rider (page link)
waiver_of_premium.quote: pay the premiums in the event of Total and Permanent Disability
waiver_of_premium.note: Unambiguous: "basic plan". Disability only. No waiver on death or critical illness in this rider (death is covered by Waiver of Premium Plus for a proposer who is not the life insured).

waiver_on_death_of_life_assured.note: The rider is a premium waiver on total and permanent disability only.
